capabilities: Chat with the local WorkBuddy agent in a sidebar with streaming Markdown replies
Send the current note or selection as context with each message
Let WorkBuddy read, search, create and edit vault notes under selectable permission modes
Copy replies or insert them at the cursor
Configure model, reasoning effort, working folder and custom instructions
extras: Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with Tencent; not yet in the community plugin list, so installation is via BRAT or manual download. Desktop only (Windows verified; macOS/Linux best-effort). Default permission mode lets the agent edit notes; Full access mode allows shell commands.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with a locally installed AI agent or let that agent read, search, create and edit vault notes.

relations.evidence: Chat with your locally installed WorkBuddy (Tencent's desktop AI agent) from inside Obsidian.

summary: Sidebar chat client for Tencent's WorkBuddy desktop AI agent that sends note context, streams replies, and lets the agent read and edit vault notes.
